say:1:1030111001:1.text: Waystone? It's this rock right beside me!
say:1:1030111001:1.source_cn: 传送石？就是我身边这块石头呀！
say:1:1030111001:1.male: Waystone? It's this rock right beside me!
say:1:1030111001:1.female: Waystone? It's this rock right beside me!

say:2:1030111002:1.text: Members of the Arcane Council infused magic into these rocks, connecting them with the leylines around the world.
say:2:1030111002:1.source_cn: 魔法师协会的人会将魔力注入这些石头，通过地脉将它们连通。
say:2:1030111002:1.male: Members of the Arcane Council infused magic into these rocks, connecting them with the leylines around the world.
say:2:1030111002:1.female: Members of the Arcane Council infused magic into these rocks, connecting them with the leylines around the world.

say:3:1030111003:1.text: With this, even a person without magic can go anywhere in the world!
say:3:1030111003:1.source_cn: 这样就算不会魔法的人，也能通过石头传送到世界各地了！
say:3:1030111003:1.male: With this, even a person without magic can go anywhere in the world!
say:3:1030111003:1.female: With this, even a person without magic can go anywhere in the world!

say:5:1030111004:1.text: How greedy do you think mages are?
say:5:1030111004:1.source_cn: 你把魔法师想得太庸俗了吧！
say:5:1030111004:1.male: How greedy do you think mages are?
say:5:1030111004:1.female: How greedy do you think mages are?

say:6:1030111005:1.text: I heard that there are spells that can turn things into gold. It wouldn't make sense for mages to charge us commoners.
say:6:1030111005:1.source_cn: 传说甚至有点石成金的魔法，为什么魔法师还要收普通人的钱啊！
say:6:1030111005:1.male: I heard that there are spells that can turn things into gold. It wouldn't make sense for mages to charge us commoners.

say:7:1030111006:1.text: Waystones were probably created so ordinary people like me could run to safety in times of danger.
